jobs.description: The media reconciler (root ADR-0387, ADR-0299 G-recon): once a day, compares the keys every Silver index of the shared media store names (data-go-kr-onbid.contract.json media.reconcile.index_tables: the onbid and the court auction photos, root ADR-0429; a table whose first load has not run names nothing) with the objects R2 holds under media.object_prefix/sha256/. A key the index names that R2 lacks is missing (a broken photo on a parcel page); an object no index row names, older than orphan_min_age_hours, is an orphan (2026-10-26: the collector hit its 40-minute limit with its Bronze commit at the end, leaving stored photos no line named). Partial: the index is append-only, so the reconciler keeps the set of keys it has named under its state path and reads only the rows ingested since the newest it read, less two hours (2026-11-04: 6,074 of 29,738 keys when nothing new landed; the first run reads all 29,738 in 4 s). The listing is keys only, about one ListObjectsV2 call per thousand objects (~30 a run, $0.000135), no object read: hashed keys cannot be listed by time. Writes a report per run under its state path and foundation_media_reconcile_* gauges for node-exporter (/var/lib/foundation-jobs/metrics/media-reconcile.prom; the FoundationMediaObject* alerts). Read-only: its outcome is always unchanged.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: An operation, not a data producer: `unchanged` is its normal outcome. That it keeps finishing is the done bound.
